   270|theorem two_mul_fract_eq_one_iff_exists_int {x : R} :
   271|    2 * fract x = 1 ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, 2 * x = 2 * n + 1 := by
   272|  rw [fract, mul_sub, sub_eq_iff_eq_add']
   273|  refine ⟨fun hx ↦ ⟨⌊x⌋, hx⟩, ?_⟩
   274|  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
   275|  convert hn
   276|  rw [floor_eq_iff, ← mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ two_pos, ← mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ two_pos, hn]
   277|  simp [mul_add]

   281|section LinearOrderedCommRing
   282|variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [FloorRing R] {a : R}
   283|
   284|theorem cast_mul_floor_div_cancel_of_pos {n : ℤ} (hn : 0 < n) (a : R) : ⌊n * a⌋ / n = ⌊a⌋ := by
   285|  rw [mul_comm, mul_cast_floor_div_cancel_of_pos hn]
   286|
   287|theorem natCast_mul_floor_div_cancel {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (a : R) : ⌊n * a⌋ / n = ⌊a⌋ := by
   288|  rw [mul_comm, mul_natCast_floor_div_cancel hn]

   292|section LinearOrderedField
   293|variable {k : Type*} [Field k] [LinearOrder k] [IsStrictOrderedRing k] [FloorRing k] {a b : k}
   294|
   295|theorem floor_div_cast_of_nonneg {n : ℤ} (hn : 0 ≤ n) (a : k) : ⌊a / n⌋ = ⌊a⌋ / n := by
   296|  obtain rfl | hn := hn.eq_or_lt
   297|  · simp
   298|  nth_rw 2 [← div_mul_cancel₀ (a := a) (ne_of_gt (Int.cast_pos.mpr hn))]
   299|  rw [mul_cast_floor_div_cancel_of_pos hn]
   300|
   301|theorem floor_div_natCast (a : k) (n : ℕ) : ⌊a / n⌋ = ⌊a⌋ / n := by
   302|  simpa using floor_div_cast_of_nonneg n.cast_nonneg a
   303|

   310|section fract
   311|
   312|@[simp]
   313|theorem self_sub_floor (a : R) : a - ⌊a⌋ = fract a :=
   314|  rfl
   315|
   316|@[simp]
   317|theorem floor_add_fract (a : R) : (⌊a⌋ : R) + fract a = a :=
   318|  add_sub_cancel _ _
   319|
   320|@[simp]
   321|theorem fract_add_floor (a : R) : fract a + ⌊a⌋ = a :=
   322|  sub_add_cancel _ _
   323|
   324|@[simp]
   325|theorem self_sub_fract (a : R) : a - fract a = ⌊a⌋ :=
   326|  sub_sub_cancel _ _
   327|
   328|@[simp]
   329|theorem fract_sub_self (a : R) : fract a - a = -⌊a⌋ :=
   330|  sub_sub_cancel_left _ _
   331|
   332|theorem fract_add (a b : R) : ∃ z : ℤ, fract (a + b) - fract a - fract b = z :=
   333|  ⟨⌊a⌋ + ⌊b⌋ - ⌊a + b⌋, by unfold fract; grind⟩
   334|
   335|variable [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
   336|
   337|@[simp]
   338|theorem fract_add_intCast (a : R) (m : ℤ) : fract (a + m) = fract a := by
   339|  rw [fract]
   340|  simp
   341|@[simp]
   342|theorem fract_add_natCast (a : R) (m : ℕ) : fract (a + m) = fract a := by
   343|  rw [fract]
   344|  simp
   345|@[simp]
   346|theorem fract_add_one (a : R) : fract (a + 1) = fract a := mod_cast fract_add_natCast a 1
   347|
   348|@[simp]
   349|theorem fract_add_ofNat (a : R) (n : ℕ) [n.AtLeastTwo] :
   350|    fract (a + ofNat(n)) = fract a :=
   351|  fract_add_natCast a n
   352|
   353|@[simp]
   354|theorem fract_intCast_add (m : ℤ) (a : R) : fract (↑m + a) = fract a := by
   355|  rw [add_comm, fract_add_intCast]
   356|@[simp]
   357|theorem fract_natCast_add (n : ℕ) (a : R) : fract (↑n + a) = fract a := by
   358|  rw [add_comm, fract_add_natCast]
   359|@[simp]
   360|theorem fract_one_add (a : R) : fract (1 + a) = fract a := mod_cast fract_natCast_add 1 a
   361|
   362|@[simp]
   363|theorem fract_ofNat_add (n : ℕ) [n.AtLeastTwo] (a : R) :
   364|    fract (ofNat(n) + a) = fract a :=
   365|  fract_natCast_add n a
   366|
   367|@[simp]
   368|theorem fract_sub_intCast (a : R) (m : ℤ) : fract (a - m) = fract a := by
   369|  rw [fract]
   370|  simp
   371|@[simp]
   372|theorem fract_sub_natCast (a : R) (n : ℕ) : fract (a - n) = fract a := by
   373|  rw [fract]
   374|  simp
   375|@[simp]
   376|theorem fract_sub_one (a : R) : fract (a - 1) = fract a := mod_cast fract_sub_natCast a 1
   377|
   378|@[simp]
   379|theorem fract_sub_ofNat (a : R) (n : ℕ) [n.AtLeastTwo] :
   380|    fract (a - ofNat(n)) = fract a :=
   381|  fract_sub_natCast a n

   383|-- Was a duplicate lemma under a bad name
   384|
   385|theorem fract_add_le (a b : R) : fract (a + b) ≤ fract a + fract b := by
   386|  rw [fract, fract, fract, sub_add_sub_comm, sub_le_sub_iff_left, ← Int.cast_add, Int.cast_le]
   387|  exact le_floor_add _ _
   388|
   389|theorem fract_add_fract_le (a b : R) : fract a + fract b ≤ fract (a + b) + 1 := by
   390|  rw [fract, fract, fract, sub_add_sub_comm, sub_add, sub_le_sub_iff_left]
   391|  exact mod_cast le_floor_add_floor a b
   392|
   393|@[simp]
   394|theorem fract_nonneg (a : R) : 0 ≤ fract a :=
   395|  sub_nonneg.2 <| floor_le _
   396|
   397|/-- The fractional part of `a` is positive if and only if `a ≠ ⌊a⌋`. -/
   398|lemma fract_pos : 0 < fract a ↔ a ≠ ⌊a⌋ :=
   399|  (fract_nonneg a).lt_iff_ne.trans <| ne_comm.trans sub_ne_zero
   400|
   401|theorem fract_lt_one (a : R) : fract a < 1 :=
   402|  sub_lt_comm.1 <| sub_one_lt_floor _
   403|
   404|@[simp]
   405|theorem fract_zero : fract (0 : R) = 0 := by rw [fract, floor_zero, cast_zero, sub_self]
   406|
   407|@[simp]
   408|theorem fract_one : fract (1 : R) = 0 := by simp [fract]
   409|
   410|theorem abs_fract : |fract a| = fract a :=
   411|  abs_eq_self.mpr <| fract_nonneg a
   412|
   413|@[simp]
   414|theorem abs_one_sub_fract : |1 - fract a| = 1 - fract a :=
   415|  abs_eq_self.mpr <| sub_nonneg.mpr (fract_lt_one a).le
   416|
   417|@[simp]
   418|theorem fract_intCast (z : ℤ) : fract (z : R) = 0 := by
   419|  unfold fract
   420|  rw [floor_intCast]
   421|  exact sub_self _
   422|
   423|@[simp]
   424|theorem fract_natCast (n : ℕ) : fract (n : R) = 0 := by simp [fract]

   427|theorem fract_ofNat (n : ℕ) [n.AtLeastTwo] :
   428|    fract (ofNat(n) : R) = 0 :=
   429|  fract_natCast n

   431|theorem fract_floor (a : R) : fract (⌊a⌋ : R) = 0 :=
   432|  fract_intCast _
   433|
   434|@[simp]
   435|theorem floor_fract (a : R) : ⌊fract a⌋ = 0 := by
   436|  rw [floor_eq_iff, Int.cast_zero, zero_add]; exact ⟨fract_nonneg _, fract_lt_one _⟩
   437|
   438|theorem fract_eq_iff {a b : R} : fract a = b ↔ 0 ≤ b ∧ b < 1 ∧ ∃ z : ℤ, a - b = z :=
   439|  ⟨fun h => by
   440|    rw [← h]
   441|    exact ⟨fract_nonneg _, fract_lt_one _, ⟨⌊a⌋, sub_sub_cancel _ _⟩⟩,
   442|   by
   443|    rintro ⟨h₀, h₁, z, hz⟩
   444|    rw [← self_sub_floor, eq_comm, eq_sub_iff_add_eq, add_comm, ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq, hz,
   445|      Int.cast_inj, floor_eq_iff, ← hz]
   446|    constructor <;> simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc] ⟩
   447|
   448|theorem fract_eq_fract {a b : R} : fract a = fract b ↔ ∃ z : ℤ, a - b = z :=
   449|  ⟨fun h => ⟨⌊a⌋ - ⌊b⌋, by unfold fract at h; rw [Int.cast_sub, sub_eq_sub_iff_sub_eq_sub.1 h]⟩,
   450|   by
   451|    rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
   452|    refine fract_eq_iff.2 ⟨fract_nonneg _, fract_lt_one _, z + ⌊b⌋, ?_⟩
   453|    rw [eq_add_of_sub_eq hz, add_comm, Int.cast_add]
   454|    exact add_sub_sub_cancel _ _ _⟩
   455|
   456|@[simp]
   457|theorem fract_eq_self {a : R} : fract a = a ↔ 0 ≤ a ∧ a < 1 :=
   458|  fract_eq_iff.trans <| and_assoc.symm.trans <| and_iff_left ⟨0, by simp⟩
   459|
   460|@[simp]
   461|theorem fract_fract (a : R) : fract (fract a) = fract a :=
   462|  fract_eq_self.2 ⟨fract_nonneg _, fract_lt_one _⟩
   463|
   464|theorem fract_neg {x : R} (hx : fract x ≠ 0) : fract (-x) = 1 - fract x := by
